input: The 256 byte values from the printed 32x8 LP2-49–51 number grid, under pinned source base-60 parsing. Six exact source byte streams: page_17.bin, page_21.bin, page_43.bin, wisdom_hint.txt, page_00 hex, onion-2 hex. Source filenames are archive identifiers, not manuscript-page identification.
key_rule: For each source, every cyclic phase o; 256 consecutive bytes from source[(o+i) mod length]. No extra offsets or normalization.
statistic: For each complete 256-byte output count D, the number of distinct byte values.
decision: PASS if any exact source/reading/op/phase has D<=120. A source/reading/op cell is EXCLUDED when none of its phases pass. Otherwise report the exact phase and output; do not call a low-D candidate meaningful plaintext by itself.
controls: All 24 source-planted positive cells must pass. No negative random grid may pass, and negative mean D must lie within 162.0±0.5. A failed gate voids all LP2 verdicts.
limitations: Only exact printed-grid bytes, the six source byte streams, four fixed routes and four byte operations; no unknown external key, cropped or transformed bytes, page-local resets, entropy models beyond the exact iid-uniform distinct count, or language interpretation.
runtime_calibration: Representative full 58152-phase, 16-cell search on a random 256-byte grid took 5.65 seconds on this host; source controls repeat searches, so full run is expected to take minutes.
